entries.subject: DAMIT 619: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-619.txt. Model 619, version 2013-02-11, pole (173°, -3°), period 4.714799 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 53.26 ± 0.62 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 166 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 620, pole ['345', '-22'], [Model 620](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/620) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 620: pole (345°, -22°), 4.714793 h, version 2013-02-11. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "26.63 km (approximate thermal scale)" (akari-acua-v1) implies a diameter of 53.26 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 128, DAMIT model 620 diameter 44 ± 1 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 620 fitted to 1 occultation). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
